plan.title: Modules 9-11: Implementation, Gates, Review, and Closeout

narratives.Description: Teach the solo implementation golden path, proof-driven testing and gates, and evidence-based PR, review, and closeout states. The work uses a fictional Node.js 20 application, node:test, and simulated review findings.
narratives.Acceptance: Learners start from a clean feature branch and active contract, pass story-ready and xBRIEF preflight, implement a narrow tested behavior, use focused checks and literal acceptance commands, diagnose a deliberate aggregate-gate failure without weakening the gate, conduct a pre-PR review, classify all simulated findings, prepare a coherent fix batch, and distinguish implementation, PR, merge readiness, delivery, deployment, and UAT evidence.
narratives.Traces: PROJECT-DEFINITION LearningGoals: proof-driven implementation and aggregate checks; pre-PR and review workflows; precise completion states
narratives.QualityGate: Run task deft:check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint after the literal acceptance command; do not embed the aggregate gate in plan.acceptance.commands.

items.title: Author Module 9 and the small test-backed implementation lab

narrative.Acceptance: A learner independently performs one smallest-coherent-change cycle from clean branch and active contract through focused evidence without unrelated scope expansion.

items.title: Author Module 10 and red-green-refactor gate lab

narrative.Acceptance: A learner produces red-green-refactor evidence, runs literal acceptance commands and the aggregate gate, diagnoses the seeded failure, and repairs the work rather than the gate.

items.title: Author Module 11 and simulated review exercise

narrative.Acceptance: A learner performs pre-PR self-review, classifies every simulated finding before editing, resolves a coherent batch, and labels completion scenarios only as far as current evidence supports.
